149: /// Create directory at a given `path`.
150: ///
151: /// ## Options
152: ///
153: /// * `recursive` --- create parent directories for the `path`, if they do not
154: ///     exist.
155: /// * `mode` --- file mode for the directories (not implemented on windows).
156: /// * `verbose` --- print a message for each printed directory.
157: ///
158: /// ## Trailing dot
159: ///
160: /// To match the GNU behavior, a path with the last directory being a single dot
161: /// (like `some/path/to/.`) is created (with the dot stripped).
162: pub fn mkdir(path: &Path, recursive: bool, mode: u32, verbose: bool) -> UResult<()> {
163:     // Special case to match GNU's behavior:
164:     // mkdir -p foo/. should work and just create foo/
165:     // std::fs::create_dir("foo/."); fails in pure Rust
166:     let path_buf = dir_strip_dot_for_creation(path);
167:     let path = path_buf.as_path();
168:     let maker = Mkdir {
169:         recursive,
170:         verbose,
171:     };
172: 
173:     maker.create_dir(&CreationTarget::from_path(path), false)?;
174:     chmod(path, mode)
175: }

177: #[cfg(any(unix, target_os = "redox"))]
178: fn chmod(path: &Path, mode: u32) -> UResult<()> {
179:     use std::fs::{set_permissions, Permissions};
180:     use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
181: 
182:     let mode = Permissions::from_mode(mode);
183: 
184:     set_permissions(path, mode)
185:         .map_err_context(|| format!("cannot set permissions {}", path.quote()))
186: }
187: 
188: #[cfg(windows)]
189: fn chmod(_path: &Path, _mode: u32) -> UResult<()> {
190:     // chmod on Windows only sets the readonly flag, which isn't even honored on directories
191:     Ok(())
192: }

201:     #[allow(unused_variables)]
202:     fn create_dir(&self, target: &CreationTarget, is_parent: bool) -> UResult<()> {
203:         if target.exists() && !self.recursive {
204:             return Err(USimpleError::new(
205:                 1,
206:                 format!("{}: File exists", target.as_path().display()),
207:             ));
208:         }
209:         if target.is_empty() {
210:             return Ok(());
211:         }
212: 
213:         if self.recursive {
214:             match target.parent() {
215:                 Some(p) => self.create_dir(&CreationTarget::from_path(p), true)?,
216:                 None => {
217:                     USimpleError::new(1, "failed to create whole tree");
218:                 }
219:             }
220:         }
221:         match std::fs::create_dir(target.as_path()) {
222:             Ok(()) => {
223:                 if self.verbose {
224:                     let notice = CreatedPathNotice::for_directory(
225:                         uucore::util_name(),
226:                         target.as_path(),
227:                     );
228:                     println!(
229:                         "{}: created directory {}",
230:                         notice.program(),
231:                         notice.quoted()
232:                     );
233:                 }
234:                 #[cfg(not(windows))]
235:                 if is_parent {
236:                     // directories created by -p have permission bits set to '=rwx,u+wx',
237:                     // which is umask modified by 'u+wx'
238:                     let spec = mode::DirectoryPermissionSpec::for_parents();
239:                     chmod(
240:                         target.as_path(),
241:                         (!spec.umask() & spec.permission_mask()) | spec.owner_write_search(),
242:                     )?;
243:                 }
244:                 Ok(())
245:             }
246:             Err(_) if target.is_dir() => Ok(()),
247:             Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
248:         }
249:     }
